findings.description: Downloaded both official list URLs (faculty and affiliated) and parsed each. Both pages yield identical entries: 22 main-block faculty and 4 affiliated faculty. The page header text "Electrical & Computer Engineering" is a college-name banner, not a person.
Enumerated all 26 people on the page and matched them to brief.people by name. No omissions in either direction; no person on the page is missing from the brief.

Checked the ECE site navigation. The only faculty-type links are Faculty (this page) and Faculty Honors and Distinctions. No emeritus, adjunct, lecturer or joint faculty category page exists in the navigation, so no additional category sources were downloaded.

No announced incoming professors appear on the official ECE list pages, so no incoming records or subtotal are created. No explicit start dates were found, so effective_from_json is null for all records.

The 19 main-block professorial ranks (Professor, Associate, Assistant, endowed/named chairs, department chair/associate chair) are decided as included/regular/current under the brief rule for the main faculty block.

Excluded as academic_professional (not_in_core). The official title 'Professor of Practice' is a practice-track, non-tenure-line appointment, and no source (list pages or profile) states an in-residence professorial appointment. Project convention: Professor of Practice titles are not an included professorial appointment.
Excluded as teaching. Official title Teaching Assistant Professor (page and profile).
Excluded as teaching. Official title Teaching Associate Professor (page and profile).
Included as affiliate_professor. Lehigh Assistant Professor (College of Health) designated by the ECE affiliated block; profile confirms ECE affiliation.
Excluded as research_staff. Current title Distinguished Research Fellow is non-professorial; the prior adjunct professorship is historical.
Included as affiliate_professor. Professorial title in the ECE affiliated block; primary department is Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering per profile, which the affiliate rule allows.
Included as affiliate_professor. Lehigh Assistant Professor (College of Health) designated by the ECE affiliated block; the profile itself does not mention ECE.
